a.xlink:title: stokvel_cycles unique (stokvel_id, cycle_number); unique (stokvel_id) where status <> closed
stokvel_members unique (stokvel_id, user_id) where left_at is null
stokvel_invitations unique (stokvel_id, invitee_user_id) where status = pending
stokvel_payouts unique (cycle_id, round); member payout_position = round (trigger)
